title: SDLC Stat v1
description: Stable JSON response envelope for read-only inspection of one Git-tracked repository file, regardless of the file's object type.
$comment: The stat command reports repository-relative identity, Git tracking state, a normalized file object kind, and bounded filesystem metadata. It does not interpret domain-specific file contents or authorize mutation.

schema.description: The stable response contract identifier. Runtime output uses sdlc/stat/v1; the canonical persisted schema URI is also accepted for schema-aware consumers.

repositoryPath.description: The normalized repository-relative path resolved for the stat operation.

tracked.description: Whether the requested path is tracked by the repository's Git index.

objectKind.description: The normalized object category for a stat response. File contents may be any supported object type, but the response envelope remains stable.

stat.description: Bounded filesystem metadata for the tracked file.

FileStat.description: Filesystem metadata intentionally limited to stable numeric size/mode and an ISO timestamp.

mtime.description: Filesystem modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

mode.description: Numeric filesystem mode reported by the local runtime.
